Name: Ryomen Sukuna (Heian) NPC - Jujutsu Kaisen
Author: yujihat
Description:
[b][size=4][u]Brief Overview[/u][/size][/b]

This mod adds in our best boy Sukuna, this time with four arms. He's a tad nicer than my first Sukuna mod, probably because he doesn't have to listen to Yuji cry all day. Datable and marryable. His name is Ryomen because he wouldn't work with the first Sukuna if I didn't name him that.  [b][size=4]
[/size][/b][size=2]
[b]He is compatible with the Gojo mod by cursedcure, and my other Sukuna mod. I have not tested him with any other NPCs yet!!![/b]

[/size][u][size=4][b]Gift Likes/Dislikes[/b][/size][/u][size=2]

[b]Loves[/b]: Tea Leaves, Green Tea, Ruby, Ancient Fruit, Peach.

[b]Likes[/b]: Milk, L Milk, Carp, Tuna, Sashimi

[b]Dislikes[/b]: Dessert items, spicy foods

[b]Hates[/b]: Trash, seeds, building items.

He is neutral to pretty much everything else.

[/size][size=4][b][u]Schedule
[/u][/b][/size][size=2]
Monday, Wednesday, Friday

0610 Starts at the docks to the left of Willy's shop.
0830 Heads up around the Community Center/park to overlook Pelican Town.
1900 Goes back to the beach.
2200 Back to his starting place on the docks.

Tuesday, Thursday

0610 Starts at the docks to the left of Willy's shop.
0830 He will start roaming around the beach. He moves spots but he will never leave the beach.
2200 Back to his starting place on the docks.

Saturday, Sunday

0610 Starts at the docks to the left of Willy's shop.
0800 Goes to the Wizard Tower
1800 Back to his starting place at the docks.

[/size][size=4][b]Heart Events

[/b][/size][size=2][size=2]Yay he finally has heart events! Here is how to trigger them <3

[b][u]Two Heart Event [/u]

[/b]On Tuesday or Thursday head to the Beach between 0600 and 1900.

[b][u]Four Heart Event [/u]

[/b]On Monday, Wednesday or Friday head to Town between 0900 and 1900.

[b][u]Six Heart Event [/u]

[/b]On Monday, Wednesday or Friday head to Town between 0900 and 1900. Don't worry, this is a different event than the four heart event :)

[b][u]Eight Heart Event [/u]

[/b]On any day head to the Bus Stop between 0600 and 1900.

[b][u]Ten Heart Event [/u]

[/b]On any day, leave your house between 0600 and 1900. [/size]He'll be there waiting for you :)

[/b][/size]

[/b][/size]
[*][size=2]Possibly a 14 heart event :) [/size]
[/list][size=2]
